articles.summary: MARLBOROUGH, Mass., May 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - - IPG Photonics Corporation (NASDAQ: IPGP), the global leader in fiber laser technology, today announced that it has entered into an agreement with TRUMPF Laser- und Systemtechnik SE to resolve and dismiss all patent litigation worldwide between the parties. Contact Eugene Fedotoff Senior Director, Investor Relations IPG Photonics Corporation 508-597-4713 efedotoff@ipgphotonics.com About IPG Photonics Corporation IPG Photonics Corporation is the leader in high-power fiber lasers and amplifiers used primarily in materials processing and other diverse applications. The Company’s mission is to develop innovative laser solutions, making the world a better place. IPG accomplishes this mission by delivering superior performance, reliability, and usability at a lower total cost of ownership compared with other types of lasers and non-laser tools, allowing end users to increase productivity and decrease costs.
